receiver: Existing fixed-ROI grayscale mean, preamble-fitted fixed clock, fixed threshold; unchanged.
roi_selection: Use earlier geometric header ROIs unchanged. No payload/CRC based ROI search.
segmentation: Optically verified packet extent plus one second per side. Decoder reacquires within each window.
timing: Actual FFprobe presentation timestamps; no average-FPS substitution.
goodput: Correct CRC-valid payload bits / scheduled channel time, including all packet guards/header/FEC/CRC; excludes operator pauses and retakes.
missing_outputs: FEC rejection: payload BER missing, packet failed, useful goodput zero. Raw sampled channel bits retained if available.
limitations: Three different message cases per method, not three identical controlled repeats.
Light disturbance, camera pose and exposure differ between recordings; no causal code ranking.
Older uncoded and MANUNITED repeat3 results are development data; new results are now inspected baseline evaluation data.
Later tuning on these results must be reported as exploratory; do not call it untouched held-out validation.
Consecutive error runs describe threshold decisions, not the exact physical disturbance duration.
